summary: Health Profile Screen Feature Testing - Backend: 10/10 tests passed (100%), Frontend: All critical features verified. The health profile page displays user bio data (age, gender, diet, BMI, stress, sleep), risk overview badges (Hoch/Mittel/Niedrig counts), color-coded deficiency cards with risk tags, priority areas, action buttons, and disclaimer. OnboardingButton on home correctly shows 'Gesundheitsprofil anzeigen' when profile exists and navigates to /health-profile.

minor.issue: Deficiency cards show technical nutrient keys (iron, zinc, omega3) instead of localized names (Eisen, Zink, Omega-3) on health-profile page. The nutrient_name field exists in API but frontend uses nutrient key.

issues: Deficiency cards display technical nutrient keys (iron, zinc, etc.) instead of German names (Eisen, Zink, etc.). The backend returns both nutrient and nutrient_name but frontend displays technical key. Priority areas also show English (sleep, stress) instead of German.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents - Non-blocking warnings

action_items: Minor: Update health-profile.tsx deficiency cards to use d.nutrient_name || d.name instead of d.nutrient for display
Minor: Add localization for priority areas (sleep->Schlaf, stress->Stress) on health profile page
critical_code_review_comments: Backend GET /api/health-profile/{id} correctly returns profile and assessment data with deficiencies, BMI, priority_areas, warnings
Frontend health-profile.tsx correctly fetches data using profile_id from AsyncStorage
OnboardingButton.tsx correctly checks AsyncStorage for health_profile_id and switches between 'Gesundheits-Check starten' and 'Gesundheitsprofil anzeigen'
Empty state shows 'Kein Profil vorhanden' with CTA button when no profile exists
Risk overview badges correctly count high/medium/low risk deficiencies
Color-coding works: red backgrounds for high risk (#FEF2F2), yellow for medium (#FFFBEB), green for low (#F0FDF4)
BMI is displayed with color-coded category (green for Normalgewicht)
seed_data_creation: Created test profile via onboarding E2E flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: HEALTH PROFILE FEATURE FULLY FUNCTIONAL. Key routes: /health-profile (profile display), /onboarding (6-step wizard). AsyncStorage keys: 'health_profile_id' (UUID), 'disclaimer_accepted' (boolean). Backend endpoints: GET /api/health-profile/{id} (returns profile + assessment), POST /api/health-profile (creates new), GET /api/onboarding/options (form options). Frontend components: health-profile.tsx uses profileStyles.ts for styling, OnboardingButton.tsx on home page checks profile existence. BMI calculation: weight/(height_in_m^2). Risk levels: high (score >= 0.8), medium (0.5-0.8), low (<0.5).
